description: Default capability for the main window: core APIs (window, event, menu) plus the dialog plugin used by File > Open and the v0.2 save / unsaved-on-close / save-failure dialogs. App commands registered via invoke_handler (read_md_file, save_md_file) are reachable via the core IPC channel without per-command ACL entries — granting per-command permissions would create a confusing dual-gate surface. v0.2 audit (issue #50): dialog:default in tauri-plugin-dialog v2.7 already grants allow-message + allow-save + allow-open, which together cover save-failure (#7), unsaved-on-close (#8), File > Open (#5), and Save As… (#7 / #49) — no new dialog permission entries needed. @tauri-apps/plugin-fs is intentionally NOT granted: file IO must flow through the canonicalize+allow-list-hardened seams in src/lib.rs (#44 + #7), not via fs:write-all. See src-tauri/tests/capabilities.rs for the pinning + scope-creep + plugin-version drift tests.
